brief.zh: 已知「我坐公交 ∨ 我骑车」「我坐公交 → 我准时到」「我骑车 → 我准时到」，证出「我准时到」。
brief.en: Given “I take the bus ∨ I cycle”, “I take the bus → I arrive on time” and “I cycle → I arrive on time”, prove “I arrive on time”.

hint.zh: 「情况一」假设「我坐公交」，「情况二」假设「我骑车」；两个框都要证出「我准时到」。
hint.en: Case one assumes “I take the bus”, case two “I cycle”; both boxes must prove “I arrive on time”.

t.zh: <level-ref to="or"></level-ref>里说过：光有一句 ∨，不知道是哪一边。现在有了框，就能每一边都假设一次。
t.en: <level-ref to="or"></level-ref> said an ∨ alone does not tell which side holds. With boxes, assume each side in turn.

t.zh: 分情况是一块有两个框的元件：接进「左边 ∨ 右边」，「情况一」假设左边，「情况二」假设右边；两个框证出同一句话，外面就得到它。
t.en: Case by case is a part with two boxes: wire in “left ∨ right”; case one assumes the left, case two the right; when both prove the same sentence, outside you get it.

after.zh: 不知道是哪一种，就每一种都证一遍。∧、∨ 的规则都不是框和套用造出来的：它们和框、套用一样，是证明器的基础元件。
after.en: Not knowing which, prove it for each. The rules of ∧ and ∨ are not built from the box and Apply: like them, they are the prover’s primitive parts.
